output.reason: [ev-4c2676e4665a] says support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration has been removed, and tells operators to make sure all clusters use KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer. That is a required operator step before the upgrade, so migration-required (mandatory work) fits. Because 0.46.0 removes the migration path, the migration has to happen on an earlier Strimzi version, so the remediation is supported. The evidence does not say exactly what fails if the operator does nothing, so a specific failure kind like upgrade-blocked would claim more than it shows.
